capabilities.heading: Grow your corporate travel business with proactive buyer discovery

capabilities.ctaText: Discover new corporations in your market
benefits: Real-time sourcing radar across 140+ metropolitan markets
Predictive account fit scoring based on historical booking patterns

capabilities.heading: Manage your corporate travel business more efficiently
capabilities.description: Make managing and responding to RFPs effortless and negotiate smarter with intelligent rate insights and automated margin optimization powered by VeloceIQ™.
benefits: Automated multi-property rate authoring with corporate policy compliance
Intelligent margin recommendations tailored to compset demand spikes
Centralized contract negotiation history with real-time audit trails

capabilities.heading: Distribute your information accurately and consistently across all channels
capabilities.description: Streamline your content to display accurate rates, amenities, and blackout rules across global distribution systems (GDS) and corporate booking tools without manual entry.
capabilities.ctaText: Automate your rate and content distribution
benefits: Direct syndication to Sabre, Amadeus, Travelport, and corporate OBTs
Instant rate parity auditing with automated discrepancy detection
Unified room type, cancellation term, and amenity taxonomy mapping

capabilities.heading: Evaluate your rates and market performance across systems
capabilities.description: Compare your historical bidding data and negotiated rates to see how you stack up against your competitive set and identify high-value yield opportunities.
benefits: Anonymized competitive set ADR and RevPAR benchmark indices
Lost bid root-cause diagnostics across pricing, location, and terms
Season-ahead demand forecasting to capture peak corporate travel windows
